source: PHC Core Rules v1.0, rules revision 1.4 (Sigil magic; docs/design/sigil-1.4-proposal.md and decision 98)

needs.other_means: any word that isn't a Subject

shape.group: glyphs of one side that touch (diagonals too); a group that isn't one straight row of 2-4 is no shape

draw.cost: the word's charge + Glyph AP + 1 Flux (TWICE 2)
draw.two_glyph_hook: a perk, trait or skill may let its caster put a second glyph on a tile (none does yet); two on a tile alone are a Stack

evoke.stand: within 1 tile of any glyph of the Line; not on a middle glyph

facing.along: on an end glyph, or next to an end and further along the Line than it: the area runs past the far end, as wide as the Line (lanes centred on its axis; for an even count the extra lane on the right of the firing direction)
facing.across: next to the glyphs from the side: row k is the Line moved k steps away from you (perpendicular; for a diagonal Line the orthogonal step away, north or south when both lead away)
facing.width: the whole Line (one lane per glyph)
facing.depth: the Reach range (+ range bonus), or 1 for Touch
facing.finished_line: you stand on the last glyph drawn, so a finished Line fires back the way you came; the preview draws it
facing.stack: with the two-glyph hook only: all around the Stack, out to the range, in sight

grammar.self_target: always allowed (your own tile), whatever the Reach: Touch's one exception; PUSH refused there; QUICKEN skips you
grammar.range_bonus: floor(0.5 x Rumination) + perks, added once to a Reach word's range, never to Touch

repeats.subjects: repeated Subjects sum their damage, healing and shields; each copy's rider applies once

refused.why: A cone needs a way to face.

grammar.multipliers: Subjects' sum x Reach x Burst x Delivery (field/turret 0.5, chain 0.75 a jump) x 0.9 per repeated glyph x Sigil multiplier (x Elemental for Elemental; x Healing given for MEND and WARD) x critical; then armour

mixes.condense+spread: x1.5 on the landing tile, x0.6 around it
mixes.condense+push: x1.5 on the landing tile, x0.7 in the cone
mixes.spread+push: the radius and the cone; anyone in both is hit once, at the better multiplier
mixes.stay+pull: whirlpool: the field drags everyone in it toward you each round

grammar.workings_with_burst: RAISE and NULL cover the Burst's tiles; VEIL and LIGHT cover their own radius or the Burst's, whichever is larger; STEP shifts everyone caught by the same offset
grammar.fizzle: the spell goes off but finds nothing it may affect: nothing happens; charge, AP and Flux are spent and its glyphs fade
grammar.skips: harmful effects skip the Downed and the surrendered; Boons don't

retired.migrate: drop it; one free word of the player's choice at the next rest

retired.why: The Line is the only shape.
Two glyphs on one tile need the two-glyph hook.

fire.look: A white-hot core flaring orange at the edges, embers lifting off the tile, a scorch left for a beat.

freeze.look: Pale blue-white frost spreading in sharp crystals from the impact, a breath of mist, the target rimed.
freeze.sound: A glassy crack and a high ring.

shock.look: A jagged blue-white arc with branches, a hard flicker of the tile, a jump between targets for CHAIN.
shock.sound: A sharp snap and electric buzz.

stone.look: Grey-brown shards and dust bursting up from the ground, a short heavy shake.
stone.sound: A deep thud and grinding crunch.

gale.look: Pale curved streaks sweeping through, dust and debris swept along the push.

spark.look: A small bright pinpoint flash and a few scattered sparks.

acid.rider: Corroded: 5 a turn and Defense -2, 3 rounds (a Body save ends it early).
acid.look: Sickly yellow-green droplets that hiss and pit the target, a thin smoke while it burns.
acid.sound: A wet splash, then a long hiss.

enemy_ai.text: Enemies with an Evoker know their stat block's words, or their tier's default set. They weigh a spell against their weapon by expected damage, walk the Line on their own tiles, avoid hitting their own side (KIN, or target choice), hold a spell that would hit more allies than enemies, set traps where players will cross, and NULL or scuff the player magic they have spotted when it threatens them.

notes: Rules 1.4: 40 words in five groups (group + class). Subjects carry their effect fields; Reach, Delivery and Burst words carry their numbers and per_copy (what each extra copy adds); every repeated glyph also multiplies the spell's damage, healing and shields by grammar.repeats.mult_per_repeated_glyph. grand is the Grand Sigilist's Grand form (the 23 words kept from 1.2). Every number is provisional.

items.name: Fire
items.text: Heat. 30 Elemental damage; on a critical the target is Burning.
items.grand: Lava floor: 10 fire damage on entering or starting a turn inside; Burning on a failed Body save.

items.name: Freeze
items.text: Cold. 25 Elemental damage; the target is Slowed (Body save).
items.grand: Ice sheet: difficult ground; a Body save each move or fall Prone.

items.name: Shock
items.text: Lightning. 30 Elemental damage; ignores half cover.
items.grand: Storm field: 15 damage at turn start to anyone in Medium armour or heavier; robots Stunned.

items.name: Stone
items.text: Earth. 35 Sigil damage; armour applies.
items.grand: Earthworks: up to 4 half-cover pillars rise where you choose.

items.name: Gale
items.text: Wind. 15 Sigil damage; pushes the target 2 tiles away from where the spell came from.
items.grand: Cyclone: anyone entering is pushed 2 tiles outward; shots through it -5.

items.name: Spark
items.text: A snap of current. 15 Elemental damage. The cheapest attack.
items.grand: Static: attack rolls of 1-3 inside jam the weapon.

items.name: Acid
items.text: Corrosion. 15 Elemental damage, and the target is Corroded (no save to land it): 5 damage at the start of each of its turns and Defense -2, for 3 rounds; a Body save at the end of each of its turns ends it early.

items.name: Bind
items.text: The target is Pinned (Body save).
items.grand: Tar: Pinned on entering (Body save).

items.name: Blind
items.text: The target is Blinded (Body save).
items.grand: Fog: no one inside sees beyond 1 tile.

items.name: Slow
items.text: The target is Slowed (Body save). No damage.
items.grand: Mire: Movement halved inside.

items.name: Muddle
items.text: The target gets a Left Brain Debuff (Brain save).
items.grand: Maze: Brain save at turn start or stagger 1 tile in a random direction.

items.name: Dread
items.text: The target is Shaken (Heart save).
items.grand: Haunting: enemies inside are Shaken (Heart save each turn).

items.name: Silence
items.text: No Sigils, Outbursts or prayers for 1 round (Brain save).
items.grand: Dead zone: no Sigils, Outbursts or prayers inside, yours included.

items.name: Command
items.text: Brain save, or the target obeys one order on its next turn: halt, kneel, drop its weapon, or move up to 3 tiles where you choose (never into harm).

items.name: Ward
items.text: A shield of 30 (x Sigil multiplier x Healing given) until the end of the fight; the higher shield stands.
items.grand: Dome: allies inside +2 Defense and a 20 shield at each turn start (does not stack).

items.name: Mend
items.text: Heals 25 (x Sigil multiplier x Healing given).
items.grand: Spring: allies starting a turn inside heal 10 x Healing multiplier.

items.name: Quicken
items.text: The target is Quickened: +2 AP on its next turn, within the ceiling of 9. At most once per target per round, and never on yourself.

items.name: Sharpen
items.text: The target is Sharpened: its next attack gets +3 to hit and x1.25 damage (until that attack or the end of its next turn).

items.name: Cleanse
items.text: Ends one condition on the target, the newest first.

items.name: Veil
items.text: Smoke-bots fill radius 1 around the target: blocks sight, 2 rounds + the Sigil duration bonus.
items.grand: Smoke field: blocks all sight; everyone inside counts as Hidden.

items.name: Light
items.text: Lights radius 4 for the scene; reveals the Hidden in it.
items.grand: Noon: Hidden revealed; enemies inside -2 to hit.

items.name: Step
items.text: Teleport: whoever it affects moves to a free tile you pick, up to 4 tiles from where they stand, past anything in between. An enemy resists with a Body save. On yourself it's a blink.

items.name: Raise
items.text: A solid barrier on each empty tile it covers: blocks movement and sight, 30 HP a tile, 3 rounds + the Sigil duration bonus. One RAISE working per caster.

items.name: Null
items.text: Dispel: removes the placed Sigil magic on the tiles it covers: glyphs (anyone's), fields, traps, turrets, and the smoke, light and walls of Workings. Keystones, Grand forms and class zones stay.

items.name: Mask
items.text: The target is Hidden until it attacks, or for 2 rounds. A Marked target can't be hidden.

items.name: Seek
items.text: A bolt, flying straight: range 8. The first creature or full cover in its way takes it or stops it; needs sight of the target.
items.grand: Hunting ground: allies' attacks on enemies inside ignore half cover.

items.name: Arc
items.text: A lob over everything: range 6, x0.8. Nothing blocks it; needs sight of the tile it lands on.

items.name: Sense
items.text: It appears at the target: range 8, x0.6, no sight needed. Nothing blocks it.

items.name: Relay
items.text: Cast from an ally's tile, as if you stood where they stand: an ally within 8 in your sight; the spell reaches that ally and the tiles next to them.

items.name: Stay
items.text: Field: the spell stands on what it covers for 2 rounds (+ the Sigil duration bonus) at x0.5, on whoever enters it or starts a turn in it. It doesn't strike when Evoked.
items.grand: Stasis: conditions inside do not tick down.

items.name: Twice
items.text: Two missiles at two targets you pick, each with its own Burst. The glyph adds 1 extra Flux.
items.grand: Echo field: the first spell each round cast by an ally inside repeats at half effect.

items.name: Pull
items.text: After the hit, drags each target it affected 3 tiles toward you (a turret's, toward the turret).
items.grand: Vortex: enemies within 4 tiles are pulled 1 tile toward the staff at their turn start.

items.name: Wait
items.text: Trap: set on the tile you aim at, hidden from the other side (they can spot it). It goes off once when someone of the other side steps on it or starts a turn on it; 3 rounds (+ the Sigil duration bonus). Your side never sets it off.

items.name: Watch
items.text: Turret: on the tile you aim at, it casts the spell at the nearest creature it can reach (allies too) at the start of each of your turns, x0.5, for 2 rounds (+ the Sigil duration bonus). 10 HP; Scuff or a hit destroys it.

items.name: Chain
items.text: After the hit, the spell jumps forward to the next creature within 3 tiles that is no closer to you (or the turret), x0.75 of the last hit; never back to one it hit; jumps can't be blocked. Allies too.

items.name: Leech
items.text: Life drain: after the hit you heal half the damage the spell dealt, in all.

items.name: Condense
items.text: One target, x1.5.
items.grand: Gravity well: everything inside is pulled 1 tile toward the staff at turn start.

items.name: Spread
items.text: Everyone within 2 tiles of where it lands (5 x 5), x0.6. It can land on empty ground.
items.grand: Bloom: any spell landing inside spreads 1 more radius.

items.name: Push
items.text: A cone from where it lands, carrying on the way the spell faced, 3 tiles long and widening, x0.7. It can land on empty ground. Refused on your own tile.
items.grand: Rampart wind: shots from outside into it -3.

items.name: Kin
items.text: Your side is never affected: you and your allies can't be picked and nothing in the spell touches you. It backfires on Boons. It changes who the spell affects, not how it flies.
